$comment: Feature/cell catalog for the validation matrix. The orchestrator expands these into concrete cells per {sdk x platform x accelerator} using the platform + availability manifests, then filters to what the current machine actually supports. 'category' drives the acceptance policy. 'runner' names the per-SDK entrypoint under validation/runners/<sdk>/.

features.desc: Install RC package into fresh isolated project; verify native load + version == 2.0.0-rc1.
Inspect package contents/identity: native assets, RID/wheel/arch tags, signatures, licenses, no internal/debug files; record hash + provenance.
Native chat completions, non-streaming + streaming, with correctness assertions.
Large chat model on accelerated path (memory/perf).
Tool/function calling, native path + web-server path; assert tool-call arguments.
Single + batch embeddings; assert vector shape/count/numeric sanity.
Whisper file transcription; assert text within tolerance of reference.
Image understanding via Responses API (web server); assert non-empty grounded description.
OpenAI-compatible web server: chat, Responses, REST + negative/lifecycle cases; OpenAI SDK against endpoint.
Catalog list, variant/EP selection, download progress+cancel, cache reuse, offline load, update, pinning.
Hostile download/cache: interrupted/resumed, checksum fail, corrupt cache, concurrent, no-disk, odd paths, cancel cleanup.
EP download/register; auto + explicit selection; documented fallback.
Cancellation, offline/error, dispose/lifecycle, concurrent sessions, telemetry privacy (network-observed).
Repeated load/unload, long streaming, cancel races, concurrency, restart, memory/handle growth, latency/startup gates.
Upgrade from latest 1.x, cache/config migration, API-break check, uninstall/reinstall, side-by-side.

feature_sdk_applicability.$comment: Overrides where a feature is not applicable to a given SDK (e.g., vision/web-server are exercised via server + OpenAI clients; C++ has no LangChain).
